name: abracadabrax-sticker-emoji-maker
description: Create a custom die-cut sticker or emoji-style icon, one design or a set of 4, 6 or 9, with optional short text, on a plain background ready to cut out, rendered in your Abracadabrax account.

interface.longDescription:
Tell ChatGPT what the sticker shows and get a custom die-cut sticker or emoji-style icon: one design or a set of 4, 6 or 9, with optional short text, on a plain background ready to cut out.

The plugin prepares a draft with the kind, the number of designs, the style and the image model. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders it and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For chats, laptops, planners and small shops.

Limitations: new stickers from text only. It does not turn uploaded photos into stickers, copy brand or copyrighted characters, or send stickers to messaging apps. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
defaultPrompt: A sleepy cat holding a coffee mug, cute kawaii sticker
A set of 6 emoji of a happy avocado with different moods
A retro sticker that says "Stay curious" with a little rocket

positive.prompt: A sleepy cat holding a coffee mug, cute kawaii sticker. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft with one die-cut sticker and the image model. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A set of 6 emoji of a happy avocado with different moods. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft with the emoji kind and 6 designs. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A retro sticker of a little rocket with the text "Stay curious". Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft with the text spelled exactly and the image model. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A cute kawaii sticker of a smiling cactus wearing sunglasses. Generate it now and send me the link when it's ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The draft is prepared, then one job starts in the signed-in Abracadabrax account; get_media_job reports the progress and, when completed, returns the absolute image URL and the Abracadabrax link. The panel shows the result.

positive.prompt: A sticker of a sleepy panda. Prepare it, then make it a set of 4 instead. Don't generate it yet.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_sticker, then update_media_project or prepare_sticker again
positive.expected_behavior: A draft is prepared, then it holds the set of 4, either updated or prepared again. Nothing is generated.

negative.prompt: Make a sticker from this selfie I attached.
Make a sticker pack of Disney princesses.
Add these stickers to my WhatsApp and send them to my sister.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing runs in the user's existing Abracadabrax account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: prepare a draft, produce it in the connected Abracadabrax account and get the image link back in the conversation.
